claims.claim: Four large banks held preliminary talks in July 2026 to buy a Fiserv debit network, arguing it would sit outside the Durbin cap. Analysts doubted the logic.
claims.quote: Banks could use a debit network to boost interchange fee revenue, arguing that they wouldn’t be subject to the Durbin Amendment
claims.title: Fiserv debit network sale skepticism abounds
claims.label: Reported
